posts.text: Namaste! 🙏 Godown mein pichhle season ka maal pada hai? Dead stock sirf jagah nahi leta, aapka paisa bhi rok deta hai. Our new free guide shows how to spot slow movers early, clear old pieces without big losses, and buy in smaller lots so less gets stuck:

That corner of unsold stock is costing you more than you think. 📦

Our new guide for clothing shop owners covers:
• Spotting slow movers before they become dead stock
• Display, pairing and WhatsApp tricks to move them
• Clearing old pieces in steps, not with one deep discount
• Buying smaller lots and reordering what sells
• A one-hour monthly dead stock check

Read it free at the link in bio.

#ClothingShop #DeadStock #RetailIndia #BoutiqueOwner #ShopOwner #InventoryManagement #SmallBusinessIndia #GarmentBazaar

For apparel brands, a retailer's dead stock is a hidden barrier to the next order.

When a shop owner in a Tier 2 or Tier 3 town is stuck with leftover pieces from a large minimum order, the money that could buy your new season is locked on their shelf. Many end up buying less, or not trying new labels at all.

Smaller, more frequent orders change that. A retailer can test a style with a few pieces, see what sells in their town, and reorder. Brands that make this easy tend to earn repeat buyers.

On GarmentBazaar, brands set their own MOQs and the wholesale price per piece is shown up front, so retailers across India can discover and order collections online, then reorder in one tap from their dashboard. Every brand and listing is reviewed before it goes live, and joining is free.

This week we also published a free guide for retailers on preventing and clearing dead stock.

Want to try new styles without getting stuck with extra pieces? Browse wholesale collections sorted by the lowest MOQ first. The price per piece and the brand's minimum order are on every listing before you sign up, and it is free for retailers. Buy small, see what sells, reorder in one tap.
